title: Hay Farming Basics and Plant Options Explained I
reason: This video provides a comprehensive guide on hay farming, detailing the process from soil preparation to feeding livestock.

tasks.task: Describe the variety of hay crops and their usage.

subtasks.text: Mention the variety of hay crops like Ryegrass, Timothy, Brome, Fescue, Bermuda grass, Orchard grass, Clovers, and Alfalfa.

tasks.task: Explain the process of hay preparation from cutting to storing.

subtasks.text: Describe how hay is prepared by cutting fresh plant material and baling it when at its most nutritional value.
